name: Summer Sports Experience and "Kids in Motion" Programming: 2022 to current
description: This dataset records scheduled sessions for two New York City recreation programs, Summer Sports Experience (S.S.E) and Kids in Motion (K.I.M), from 2022 to the present. Each row represents a single session at a specific park or playground, identified by borough and site name, along with the date and time it was scheduled. The sportsplayed field indicates which activity was offered, though it is blank for most rows; where populated, it most often lists "Various Sports," followed by basketball, flag football, soccer, and pickleball. The kimorsse column identifies which of the two programs the session belongs to, with K.I.M accounting for about 89% of records. Attendance figures capture how many people participated, ranging from zero to over 1,500 with a typical session drawing roughly 15 to 115 attendees. A cancellation column, populated for about 18% of rows, notes why a session did not take place, such as bad weather, staff call-outs,
